text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian conquers the Hanshin 
Daishoten. Yet her thirst remains 
unquenched.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, some alarming news 
arrives. They say Mejiro McQueen and 
Mihono Bourbon are both entering the Tenno 
Sho (Spring)...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian and her Trainer decide. To 
face them, they will run in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)—!
